text_block_list.text:
I head to the dance studio at Кинг Хало's
request.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Today, you shall have the privilege of
watching
my royal dance lesson.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
You'll see first-rate dancing up close and

personal, so you better appreciate it!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: One, two, three! ♪ One, two, three! ♪
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
You're supposed to chant "King" here,
okay?
Aaaaand, go!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Not "huh"! Do the chant!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
A first-rate chant helps liven up the
whole
audience at a concert.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter if we're just
practicing—I want it
to feel like the real
thing!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Otherwise, this is a waste of time.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list:
I see what you mean, but it might be a little
difficult...

text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose it is unreasonable to
expect you
to create the atmosphere of
a concert all by
yourself.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I wonder if we should invite some
younger
students to help set the right
mood...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: Then it would be just like the real thing!

Don't worry. I can belt out that chant with the
power of an entire audience!

text_block_list.text:
That settles it. The more cheers there
are, the
more exciting it will be!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: One, two, three! ♪ One, two, three! ♪
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: King! ♪ King! ♪
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Followers

text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! That's more like it!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Now to show you a first-rate dance!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Wooooo! ☆ King is number one!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Followers

text_block_list.text:
Now, everyone join in and make it even
more
exciting!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
You've been granted the privilege of
dancing
beside your king! Come forth!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Yaaay! ♪
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало's Followers

text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's the spirit!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's push this dance to the
limit!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: One, two, three! ♪ One, two, three! ♪
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Time for the chant!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Once more, with more gusto! Stay in
time with the
beat!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Yes, that's it!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm speeding up the tempo now, so make
sure to
keep up!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Ohohohoho! Feast your eyes on this
first-rate
dance!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало's dance is truly a lively and
energizing
experience.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Before I know it, the dance lesson
becomes a
dance party, but it's effective
nonetheless.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
